checks: Seven resources: one service account, three Services, two Deployments and one StatefulSet
No Secret, RBAC, ingress, gateway, cluster-scoped resources or standalone storage objects
ClusterIP only, headless db identity, api:8080 Nginx and db:3306 JDBC
No host network, PID, IPC, host port or hostPath
Single replica per workload and Recreate for the sample bootstrap API
Service account and all Pods disable Kubernetes API token automount
API and web run nonroot with read-only root, RuntimeDefault, no escalation and no capabilities
Writable /tmp is isolated in bounded emptyDir for both app containers
API startup/liveness exclude DB while readiness uses the DB-aware health group
DB startup/readiness use the official healthcheck; liveness checks only the TCP listener
All three password references use only the existing Secret and no literal value
Dedicated 10Gi local-path PVC remains on StatefulSet removal and scale-down
Every container has CPU, memory and ephemeral storage requests/limits
MariaDB image matches the repository digest lock
API/web fixture references are clearly unpublished and digest-shaped
